method: Four binary documented signals, 25 points each. Missing dimensions remain unknown. The displayed total is an evidence floor, not a completed rating, and must not be used as an ordinal ranking of actual political power. Sources describe events at their own dates; this is not a simultaneous 2026 political snapshot.

publicRole.text: Musk held a temporary US government advisory role in 2025; AP reported his departure in May. This records a historical role, not a claim of current office.

stateBusiness.text: NASA awarded SpaceX a $2.89 billion lunar-lander contract in 2021. A public contract establishes a state-business relationship, not improper favoritism or dependence of all revenue on government.

information.text: AP reported Musk's acquisition of Twitter and its subsequent transfer into his xAI company in March 2025. This is a documented historical information-platform ownership signal.

stateBusiness.text: NASA selected Bezos-founded Blue Origin for a $3.4 billion lunar-lander contract. Corporate exposure is attributed through the founder; this does not measure Bezos's personal income or political favors.

information.text: The Washington Post's corporate history records its 2013 sale to Jeff Bezos. Media ownership is an influence channel, not proof of editorial interference.

publicRole.text: Bloomberg's official biography records three terms as mayor of New York City. The signal includes former public office, not only current office.

information.text: Bloomberg identifies Michael Bloomberg as its majority owner; Bloomberg News is part of the company.

stateBusiness.text: The US Defense Department selected Google as a JWCC cloud vendor in 2022. Page is a co-controlling Alphabet founder, not the direct individual recipient of the contract.
stateBusiness.source: US Department of Defense · JWCC vendors

information.text: Alphabet's annual report describes Page and Brin's combined voting control. We interpret control of Google's search and YouTube distribution as an information-platform signal, not ownership of all content on those platforms.

market.text: The DOJ reports a 2024 district-court monopoly finding against Google and subsequent remedies. This is a company-level court finding, not a personal finding against Page; it is not represented as an unappealable final judgment.

stateBusiness.text: Google was selected for the Defense Department's JWCC procurement. Brin's connection is through Alphabet's founders' combined voting control, not a personal contract.
stateBusiness.source: US Department of Defense · JWCC vendors

information.text: Alphabet's report describes joint founder voting control. The project treats Google search and YouTube distribution as an information channel; this is an explicit editorial interpretation.

market.text: Google was the subject of a district-court monopoly finding and remedies reported by the DOJ. Attribution to Brin reflects corporate control, not personal legal liability; appeal finality is not assumed.

information.text: Meta's 2025 proxy reports Zuckerberg holding 61% of voting power. The project interprets control of Meta's social platforms as an information-distribution channel, not a claim about specific political conduct.

stateBusiness.text: Oracle, whose cofounder and chairman is Ellison, was selected as a JWCC cloud vendor. This is a documented government-business connection, not evidence of wrongdoing or a measure of revenue dependence.
stateBusiness.source: US Department of Defense · JWCC vendors

information.text: Ambani-led Reliance announced completion of its Disney media joint venture in November 2024. The project attributes this media-company connection through his leadership, not personal ownership of every joint-venture asset.

NDTV's annual-report timeline records Adani Group's acquisition of a 64.71% majority stake. Corporate media control is attributed through Adani's group leadership, not treated as proof of political interference.
